evidence.quote: Several open problems are discussed, e.g.: 1) One should have an effective way to check whether a metric on M^n can be isometrically embedded into another manifold with dimension n(n+1)/2; 2) What is the necessary and sufficient condition for a set of discrete numbers in R^+ to be the spectrum of the Laplacian of some compact manifold?
